content:
marco: FYI we're pushing the PriceLens mini-slate to staging tonight. Need final FAQ, calculator flow, and webinar routing before the soft-launch. :sparkles:
elaine: Love the name. For FAQ, keep 3 micro-answers: billing, commitments, security. Each answer 1 sentence + a 'Learn more' link back to docs.
kevin: Tier naming suggestion: Lite / Team / Committed -> Lite, Team, Committed (short + friendly). I'll add clarifying microcopy under each tier.
sam: Routing rec: estimator interactions -> Growth AE; email-captured partials -> SDR nurture; signals >= $5k -> Enterprise AE. Add tag "pricelens_estimator" to those leads.
nina: Calculator UX: show instant 2-line summary (monthly est + p95 latency delta). If user clicks "Download full breakdown" show modal asking email, then reveal PDF and latency table. Ops want that p95 stat in the preview.
marco: Add a conservative bench blurb in the results: "Representative perf: Hosted ~120ms median, Dedicated <30ms p95" with link to benchmark doc. Keep language defensible.
kevin: CTA wording: main button -> "Estimate your bill"; secondary -> "Get full breakdown". Also experiment variant with "See price range" vs exact numbers.
elaine: I'll prepare two FAQ placements: inline under pricing and collapsed accordion. A/B test to see which reduces support clicks.
sam: For tracking + webhooks: create tags pricelens_v1 and webinar_pricelens_2026; webhooks to /hooks/estimator and /hooks/webinar_signals. Also include UTM template: ?utm_source=pricelens&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pricelens_launch.
growth-bot: tags created: pricelens_v1, webinar_pricelens_2026. Webhooks configured at /hooks/estimator and /hooks/webinar_signals.
kevin: Quick UX Q: default slider value 10k tokens/mo or 100k? I vote 10k to not scare small teams.
nina: 10k default + ops toggle to show Dedicated vs Hosted p95. Also surface a one-row table comparing costs + latency for selected config.
marco: Good. We should also capture a "sales_handshake" event when SFDC owner is assigned. Use that to measure lead quality.
elaine: FAQ copy drafts posted in Figma. Short, scannable. Will link into staging variants.
sam: Send cohorts: 1) trial users; 2) recent estimator interactions (30d). Two separate sends with UTM params.
kevin: Implementation note: partial preview -> email modal -> success state should show CTA to register for launch webinar. Keep flow under 3 clicks.
nina: Events to track: pricelens_preview_shown, pricelens_email_capture, pricelens_submit, faq_expand, faq_doc_click, sales_handshake.
growth-bot: Analytics events registered: pricelens_preview_shown, pricelens_email_capture, pricelens_submit, faq_expand, faq_doc_click, sales_handshake.
marco: Timeline: copy freeze by EOD tomorrow; staging QA Wed; soft-launch Thu; webinar opens Fri. I'll collate tasks and ping when copy is final. :thumbsup:
